verdict.rationale: The AMD Instinct MI325X is a datacenter GPU accelerator, and user-configured autonomous background automations (an agentic product feature) are outside this product type's axis. The Spur entry describes an ecosystem cluster job scheduler that queues compute jobs. It is not evidence that the accelerator offers user-set-up autonomous automations, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
